title: Season 1
overview: Jennifer Walters leads the Superhuman Law Division while breaking the fourth wall.

episodes.title: A Normal Amount of Rage
episodes.overview: Jennifer Walters is exposed to Bruce Banner’s blood and learns to control her Hulk transformation.

episodes.title: Superhuman Law
episodes.overview: Jen is hired to lead the Superhuman Law Division and must represent Emil Blonsky.

episodes.title: The People vs. Emil Blonsky
episodes.overview: Wong testifies on Emil Blonsky’s behalf at his parole hearing.

episodes.title: Is This Not Real Magic?
episodes.overview: Jen assists Wong in a case against an unauthorized mystic arts performer.

episodes.title: Mean, Green, and Straight Poured into These Jeans
episodes.overview: Jen is sued by Titania for trademark infringement over the She-Hulk name.

episodes.title: Just Jen
episodes.overview: Jen attends a friend’s wedding while Nikki and Mallory investigate Intelligencia.

episodes.title: The Retreat
episodes.overview: Jen spends a weekend at Emil Blonsky’s wellness retreat.

episodes.title: Ribbit and Rip It
episodes.overview: Jen teams up with Matt Murdock / Daredevil on a case and against the Leap-Frog.

episodes.title: Whose Show Is This?
episodes.overview: Jen breaks through Marvel’s Fourth Wall and demands a better finale from K.E.V.I.N.
